name: v0.6.3
body:
Release notes for `v0.6.3` are available here: https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md


## What's Changed
* chore: replace `rustsec/audit-check` action with `pirafrank/audit-check-action` by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/220
* chore(deps): bump the security-updates group with 8 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/219
* chore(deps): bump the security-updates group across 1 directory with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/223
* chore(deps): bump serial_test from 3.5.0 to 4.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/222
* chore(deps): bump the security-updates group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/224
* chore(deps): bump the security-updates group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/225
* chore(deps): bump the security-updates group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/226
* chore(deps): cargo update with h2 update (RUSTSEC-2026-0258) by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/228
* Harden install, archive extraction, and release handling by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/238
* chore(deps): bump the security-updates group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/239
* chore(deps): bump sevenz-rust2 from 0.21.6 to 0.22.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/230
* Add signed release provenance, SBOMs, and build environment record by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/240
* security: pin release versions in install tooling by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/241
* security(ci): Harden GitHub Actions workflows and tighten CI checks by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/242
* security: harden and verify Cross release build images by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/243
* migrate to Rust 2024 edition, remove lazy_static dependency, and isolate tests by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/244
* security: remove compressed archive metadata by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/245
* chore(deps): bump sevenz-rust2 from 0.22.2 to 0.24.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/248
* chore(deps): bump dirs from 6.0.0 to 7.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/247
* fix: better handling of multi-asset repositories by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/246
* fix: `use` command should not link to empty installs by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/249
* fix: do not install assets that have .so in their filename by @pirafrank in https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/pull/250


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pirafrank/poof/compare/v0.6.2...v0.6.3
